Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - CC/960/2022

Dear Mr. Pawar,

Thank you for meeting us on 10 December 2022 about your dispute with Fernandes Constructions. As we understand it, the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate.

Our advice is to seek a full refund with interest because the builder failed to obtain the occupancy certificate. Please collect the builder-buyer agreement, payment receipts and the municipal reply on the occupancy certificate and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
